newsitem.title: UK: Sedgwick buys most of Transamerica's RTI.
newsitem.headline: Sedgwick buys most of Transamerica's RTI.

text.p: Sedgwick Group Plc said on Tuesday that it has agreed to buy a further 50 percent stake in River Thames Insurance Company Ltd. (RTI), lifting its holding to 99 percent, for a maximum 14 million stg.
It bought the stake off U.S. financial giant Transamerica Corp.
Sedgwick, a British-based insurance broker, will pay 12 million stg for the stake and up to two million stg more based on the profitability of RTI in the five years to December 2001.
The purchase price represents a significant discount to book value of the share of net assets bought, which amounts to 28 million stg.
It said the initial impact of the acquisition on its profits and net assets will be broadly neutral. Sedgwick announced in November 1996 that RTI would cease underwriting.
Sedgwick expects to receive, over a period of time, cash at least equivalent to net assets which total 57 million stg.
